scope: T10X01 rehearsal 1: reset, seed, mechanical preflight, AI preflight, and the live storyboard. The live payment slice passed on the local rehearsal stack; the full storyboard run and the recorded video remain.

commands: make demo-reset -> after: 0 rows across counted tables
make demo-seed -> 5 demo lots across 4 pools, sim=10000
python tools/agent_market.py --self-check -> adversary_attempts=6, breaches_succeeded=0, paypal_writes_from_ai_surface=0, one bid with a 64-hex receipt
public audit: every LIVE_SANDBOX pool recomputes its rules hash; 3 closed pools publish a commitment root beside the checkpoint
browser audit page: rules Match, entry list Match, seal 75 verifies with FairPool's published key

ai.note: Ran against GEMINI_API_KEY in .env. A stale Windows User environment variable shadows .env for inherited processes, so the run used env -u plus load_dotenv(override=True); the rehearsal API and worker start the same way.

local_stack.frontend: http://localhost:5180 (Vite dev server, proxy target http://localhost:8001)
local_stack.api: http://127.0.0.1:8001 against the loopback demo database, real PayPal Sandbox router, PAYMENT_MODE=authorize_capture, PAYPAL_APPROVAL_UI=sdk_popup, AI on
local_stack.worker: fairpool.worker draining Postgres jobs (order.authorize, order.capture, reconciler.sweep)
local_stack.session_note: the __Host-session cookie is Secure; a real browser accepts it on http://localhost (verified), while non-browser clients over http do not
